title: Branch the Flag Fix into Atomic Commits
description:
**SITUATION:**

Forgeboard ships from `main`. That branch stays deployable — nobody lands work straight on it, even a one-line config rescue.

Someone set `agentic_sprints_default = full` on `main`, so **every** enterprise got the full agentic-sprint toolkit. Early access was supposed to stay tenant-by-tenant. You already fixed the default back to `beta` in your working tree, and while you were in there you also documented how to run the service in `README.md` and added a version banner in `src/main.py`. All three edits are still uncommitted — one giant dirty diff on top of a broken `main`.

Core will not take a dump onto `main`, and they will not take a single "stuff" commit either. Open a short-lived fix branch, turn the mess into **three** commits a reviewer can skim (one story each), push that branch to the team remote, and leave `main` exactly where you found it.

Your identity (`Ada Learner`) is already configured. `origin` already points at `git.forgeboard.internal`.

**YOUR TASK:**

1. In `~/sprint-service`, create a branch named `fix/agentic-default` from `main` (your dirty edits travel with you).
2. On that branch, create **exactly three** commits — one per file — covering `config/app.conf`, `README.md`, and `src/main.py`, each with a clear, specific subject.
3. Push `fix/agentic-default` to `origin`. Do not push or update `main`. Leave a clean working tree without losing or altering any edit.

hints: Start with `git status` and `git diff` so you see every dirty file.
Branch first: `git switch -c fix/agentic-default`. Uncommitted edits come with you.
Do not commit on `main`. `git show main:config/app.conf` should still show `agentic_sprints_default = full`.
Stage one file at a time — avoid `git add .` so each commit stays one story.
`git diff --staged` shows exactly what the next commit will contain.
When the three commits look right: `git push -u origin fix/agentic-default`. Do not push `main`.
problemStatement.overview: Open a fix branch, land three atomic commits, push the branch, and leave main untouched.

problemStatement.solution:
# Solution — Branch the Flag Fix into Atomic Commits

## 1. Look around

```bash
cd ~/sprint-service
git status
git diff --stat
git remote -v
grep agentic_sprints_default config/app.conf
```

`main` still has the bug committed. Your working tree already holds three uncommitted edits. `origin` is the team forge.

## 2. Branch first

```bash
git switch -c fix/agentic-default
git branch --show-current
```

## 3. One commit per file

```bash
git add config/app.conf
git diff --staged
git commit -m "Keep agentic sprints default on beta for tenant rollouts"

git add README.md
git commit -m "Document how to run sprint-service locally"

git add src/main.py
git commit -m "Add version constant and print it in the banner"
```

## 4. Push the fix branch (not main)

```bash
git push -u origin fix/agentic-default
git status
git log --stat --oneline --all --graph
git show main:config/app.conf | grep agentic_sprints_default
```

If a commit grabbed too much: `git reset --soft HEAD~1` (or `git reset HEAD~1`), then stage more carefully.
